newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 141 of May 31, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 141 of May 31, 1997.

text.p: * (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
* COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 990/97 of 30 May 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 989/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing Community producer prices for carnations and roses for the application of the import arrangements for certain floricultural products originating in Cyprus, Israel, Jordan and Morocco

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 988/97 of 30 May 1997 introducing transitional measures relating to the detailed rules for the application of Council Regulation (EC) No 2202/96 as regards lemons delivered for processing during part of the 1997/98 marketing year

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 987/97 of 30 May 1997 amending Regulation (EC) No 1066/95 laying down detailed rules for the application of Council Regulation (EEC) No 2075/92 as regards the raw tobacco quota system for the 1995, 1996 and 1997 harvests
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 986/97 of 30 May 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 189/77 laying down detailed rules for the application of the system of minimum stocks in the sugar sector

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 985/97 of 30 May 1997 terminating the investigation concerning the circumvention of definitive anti-dumping measures imposed by Council Regulation (EC) No 993/93 on imports of certain retail electronic weighing scales originating in Japan by imports of the same product assembled in and/or transhipped through Indonesia, and ceasing registration of this product

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 984/97 of 30 May 1997 terminating the investigation concerning the circumvention of anti-dumping measures imposed by Council Regulations (EEC) No 993/93 and (EEC) No 2887/93 on imports of certain electronic weighing scales originating in Japan and Singapore, by imports of parts thereof assembled in the European Community and ceasing registration of these parts

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 983/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing the maximum buying-in price and the quantities of beef to be bought in under the 182nd partial invitation to tender as a general intervention measure pursuant to Regulation (EEC) No 1627/89
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 982/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing the export refunds on beef and veal

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 981/97 of 29 May 1997 imposing provisional anti-dumping duties on imports of certain seamless pipes and tubes of iron or non-alloy steel originating in Russia, the Czech Republic, Romania and the Slovak Republic

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 980/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing the rates of refunds applicable to certain products from the sugar sector exported in the form of goods not covered by Annex II to the Treaty
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 979/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing the rate of the refunds applicable to certain milk products exported in the form of goods not covered by Annex II to the Treaty
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 978/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing an export tax on cereal products
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 977/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing the corrective amount applicable to the refund on cereals
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 976/97 of 30 May 1997 setting the amounts of aid for the supply of rice products from the Community to the Azores and Madeira
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 975/97 of 30 May 1997 setting the amounts of aid for the supply of rice products from the Community to the Canary Islands
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 974/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing the export refunds on rice and broken rice
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 973/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing the import duties in the rice sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 972/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing the export refunds on syrups and certain other sugar products exported in the natural state
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 971/97 of 30 May 1997 altering the export refunds on white sugar and raw sugar exported in the natural state

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 970/97 of 30 May 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 391/92 setting the amounts of aid for the supply of cereals products from the Community to the French overseas departments
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 969/97 of 30 May 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 1833/92 setting the amounts of aid for the supply of cereals products from the Community to the Azores and Madeira
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 968/97 of 30 May 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 1832/92 setting the amounts of aid for the supply of cereals products from the Community to the Canary Islands
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 967/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing the refunds applicable to cereal and rice sector products supplied as Community and national food aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 966/97 of 30 May 1997 fixing the import duties in the cereals sector

COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 965/97 of 26 May 1997 opening and providing for the management of autonomous Community tariff quotas for certain live fish originating in the Slovak Republic and the Czech Republic END OF DOCUMENT.
